```{r}
# ---- Minimal deterministic loader (explicit column names) ----
library(dplyr); library(stringr); library(ggplot2); library(broom); library(effectsize); library(readr)

path <- r"(D:\Dropbox\USD\Dissertation\Collab folder\Data\Dissertation+-+Study+2+-+Wave4+_October+6,+2025_19.08.csv)"

raw0 <- readr::read_csv(
  path,
  col_types = cols(.default = col_character()),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

# 1) Drop the first two header-ish rows (labels + ImportId JSON)
stopifnot(nrow(raw0) >= 3)
dat <- raw0[-c(1,2), , drop = FALSE]

# 2) Keep finished only (exact header "Finished")
dat <- dat %>% filter(Finished %in% c("True","true","1"))

# 3) Coerce duration and score (exact headers)
dat[["Duration (in seconds)"]] <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(dat[["Duration (in seconds)"]]))
dat[["SC0"]]                   <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(dat[["SC0"]]))
dat$score <- dat[["SC0"]]

# Sanity
stopifnot(nrow(dat) > 0)
stopifnot(!all(is.na(dat$score)))
stopifnot("Version" %in% names(dat))

# 4) Derive factors from Version (exact header)
dat$Version <- stringr::str_squish(dat$Version)

chart <- stringr::str_match(dat$Version, "(High|Medium|Low)Chartjunk$")[,2]
hier  <- stringr::str_remove(dat$Version, "(High|Medium|Low)Chartjunk$")

dat$chartjunk <- factor(chart, levels = c("Low","Medium","High"), ordered = TRUE)
dat$hierarchy <- factor(
  dplyr::recode(hier,
    "NoHierarchy"         = "NoHierarchy",
    "FloorplanHierarchy"  = "FloorplanHierarchy",
    "RoomHierarchy"       = "RoomHierarchy",
    "ImportanceHierarchy" = "ImportanceHierarchy",
    .default = NA_character_
  ),
  levels = c("NoHierarchy","FloorplanHierarchy","RoomHierarchy","ImportanceHierarchy")
)


```

```{r}
# ---- Attention + Longstring filters (Wave4+) ----
# expects a data frame named `dat`; produces `dat_final`
# also writes `exclude_reason`, `longstring_run`
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr); library(stringr)
})

`%||%` <- function(a,b) if (is.null(a) || length(a)==0) b else a

# ---------- 1) Attention filter ----------
attn_col <- "Q20"
if (length(attn_col) > 1) attn_col <- attn_col[1]

if (!length(attn_col)) {
  message("Attention question not found — keeping all rows.")
  dat_attn <- dat
  dat_attn$exclude_reason <- NA_character_
} else {
  keep_idx <- grepl("smart[[:space:]]*home", dat[[attn_col]], ignore.case = TRUE)
  keep_idx[is.na(keep_idx)] <- FALSE
  dat$exclude_reason <- ifelse(keep_idx, NA_character_, "attention_fail")
  dat_attn <- dat[keep_idx, , drop = FALSE]
  message(sprintf("Attention filter kept %d / %d rows.", sum(keep_idx, na.rm = TRUE), nrow(dat)))
}




if (!length(resp_cols)) {
  dat_attn$longstring_run <- NA_integer_
  message("No Q1–Q20 response columns found; skipping longstring.")
} else {
  dat_attn$longstring_run <- vapply(
    seq_len(nrow(dat_attn)),
    function(i) {
      rr <- dat_attn[i, resp_cols, drop = FALSE]
      pr <- if (use_pos) dat_attn[i, pos_cols, drop = FALSE] else NULL
      ls_one(rr, pr)
    },
    integer(1)
  )

  # Same Tukey fence you used before to flag outliers
  q3  <- stats::quantile(dat_attn$longstring_run, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
  iqr <- stats::IQR(dat_attn$longstring_run, na.rm = TRUE)
  thr <- q3 + 1.5 * iqr
  flag <- dat_attn$longstring_run > thr

  dat_attn$exclude_reason <- ifelse(
    is.na(dat_attn$exclude_reason) & flag, "longstring_outlier",
    ifelse(!is.na(dat_attn$exclude_reason) & flag,
           paste(dat_attn$exclude_reason, "+ longstring_outlier"),
           dat_attn$exclude_reason)
  )

  dat_final <- dat_attn[!flag, , drop = FALSE]
  cat("careless::longstring (", if (use_pos) "with" else "without",
      " per-row randomized order): threshold >", round(thr, 2),
      " | removed ", sum(flag, na.rm = TRUE), " rows.\n", sep = "")
}

# From here on, use `dat_final`

dat = dat_final

```
```{r}



# 5) Quick counts + summaries
cell_counts <- dat %>% count(hierarchy, chartjunk, name = "n")
print(cell_counts)

summ <- dat %>%
  group_by(hierarchy, chartjunk) %>%
  summarise(
    n = sum(!is.na(score)),
    mean_sc0 = mean(score, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_sc0   = sd(score, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_sc0   = sd_sc0 / sqrt(pmax(n, 1)),
    ci95_lo  = mean_sc0 - qt(0.975, df = pmax(n-1, 1)) * se_sc0,
    ci95_hi  = mean_sc0 + qt(0.975, df = pmax(n-1, 1)) * se_sc0,
    .groups = "drop"
  )
print(summ)

# 6) Safe ANOVA (step down if a factor has <2 levels)
ana_dat <- dat %>% filter(!is.na(hierarchy), !is.na(chartjunk), !is.na(score))
hlev <- nlevels(droplevels(ana_dat$hierarchy))
clev <- nlevels(droplevels(ana_dat$chartjunk))

if (hlev >= 2 && clev >= 2) {
  fit <- aov(score ~ hierarchy * chartjunk, data = ana_dat)
} else if (hlev >= 2) {
  fit <- aov(score ~ hierarchy, data = ana_dat)
} else if (clev >= 2) {
  fit <- aov(score ~ chartjunk, data = ana_dat)
} else {
  stop("No variation in predictors: both hierarchy and chartjunk have <2 observed levels.")
}
print(summary(fit))
print(effectsize::eta_squared(fit, partial = FALSE))

# 7) Plot (optional)
p <- ggplot(summ, aes(x = chartjunk, y = mean_sc0, ymin = ci95_lo, ymax = ci95_hi)) +
  geom_point() + geom_errorbar(width = 0.15) +
  facet_wrap(~ hierarchy, nrow = 1) +
  labs(x = "Chartjunk", y = "Mean SC0 (±95% CI)", title = "SC0 by Hierarchy × Chartjunk") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
ggsave("out/sc0_by_condition.png", p, width = 9, height = 3.6, dpi = 150)

print(p)
```

sumdat <- dat %>%
  group_by(hierarchy) %>%
  summarise(
    n = dplyr::n(),
    mean = mean(score, na.rm = TRUE),
    se = sd(score, na.rm = TRUE)/sqrt(n),
    lower = mean - qt(.975, n - 1) * se,
    upper = mean + qt(.975, n - 1) * se,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

p = ggplot(sumdat, aes(hierarchy, mean)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper), width = .15) +
  labs(y = "Mean score (95% CI)", x = "Hierarchy") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
print(p)
